newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Kiwi dollar recoups weekend dip, TWI stabilises.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi dollar recoups weekend dip, TWI stabilises.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar edged a touch higher in light, lacklustre trade on Tuesday as investors' attention remained elsewhere, dealers said.
The Kiwi closed at US$0.6882/89 and at 67.67 on its Trade-Weighted Index from 0.6875/83 and 67.70 at the open.
"I think most of the attention has been on other currencies, Kiwi's taken a bit of back seat," said one dealer.
But he said the Kiwi would be reasonably well offered on any rally while the Australian dollar remained under pressure.
The Kiwi was seen trading in a 0.6860-90 range overnight.
